meta.name: Anjaan Rural Myths
meta.description: Spine-chilling stories of malevolent spirits unfold in villages, jungles and haunted buildings across India.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A water-drenched spirit pursues a man after a series of omens portend bad news for a couple who are dealing with a medical emergency.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: A man runs across a hooded figure carrying a lantern in the woods one night; a soldier warns his comrade about a ghost without a head who resides in the woods.

videos.title: Episode #3
videos.overview: A young boy chases after a ball and encounters an evil presence who disappears with him in a cloud of black smoke. Years later the boy's friend wakes from a recurring nightmare.

videos.title: Episode #4
videos.overview: High in the mountains, something stalks a family; a couple prepares to marry in the mountains, anxious about all the people they've upset..

videos.title: Episode #5
videos.overview: Villagers fear being attacked by a Nishi, a supernatural being who comes out into the open at midnight on a new moon.

videos.title: Episode #6
videos.overview: Shazia takes an old, deserted route on the way to fetch a doctor for her mother, and unintentionally provokes something supernatural.

videos.title: Episode #7
videos.overview: Gauri is on the run with her baby and father-in-law, and they decide to take shelter in the village of Nimua, not knowing what strange things are happening inside.

videos.title: Episode #8
videos.overview: When Satish Sahu and his new wife Babita move for his new job at Jhabra Police Station, the driver reveals strange behaviour taking precautions against the toni witch.

videos.title: Episode #9
videos.overview: One night a woman arrives at Galaxy Hospital, but she is already dead. However, someone overhears her singing a lullaby.

videos.title: Episode #10
videos.overview: A woman purchases a large property to open a school for underprivileged children, but the neighbours claim the house is haunted by a munja.

videos.title: Episode #11
videos.overview: As Dev and Indrani celebrate their marriage, not everyone is as happy as they are. Indrani begins to have unsettling dreams.

videos.title: Episode #12
videos.overview: Three friends are in trouble when one of them forgets to book a hotel for their holiday, but they seem to get lucky when a stranger approaches them.

videos.title: Episode #13
videos.overview: When Mohona's older sister Anu returns after a three year absence, she behaves strangely and barely talks to her family.

videos.title: Episode #14
videos.overview: When botanist Tanu goes into the forest to study wild plants, her grandmother worries that she'll be possessed by a ghost.

videos.title: Episode #15
videos.overview: Aniket suddenly disappears after Priya finally says yes to his proposal; Aarti, Pawan, and Ranjeet play a dirty trick on Priyanka in the forest.
